text:
Leah (People Ops): Drafting a focused "Week 1 for Managers" checklist + a measurable 30/60/90 template. Aimed at busy managers who want concrete outcomes. Please skim and add missing essentials. Canonical doc: https://redwood.ok/manager-week1-brief :wave:

Leah (People Ops): Quick bullets: pre-day checks (hardware, accounts, invite buddy), Day1 (org + manager 1:1 + team intros), Day2 (product & infra orientation), Day3 (local dev + starter PR), Day4 (cross-team intros + draft 30/60/90), Day5 (ship/observe + feedback).

Diego (Eng Manager): Love it. Couple asks: 1) can we include a short "Manager 1:1 script" with prompts? 2) include measurable examples for 30/60/90 (not vague).

Leah (People Ops): Yes to both. Adding a 1:1 prompt set and concrete metrics.

Maya (DevEx): Suggest auto-labeling starter PRs with "onboard-starter" and a linked starter-issues page. Also add a quick local-dev cheat: https://redwood.ok/dev-setup (will DM starter PRs).

Ivy (IT): Note for managers: submit IT provisioning form ASAP: https://redwood.ok/it-provision. Requests before 10:00 PST on start day normally get same-day hardware and VPN. For special keys (KMS/HSM) include manager approval in the ticket.

Leah (People Ops): Manager 1:1 script (10-15m) - prompts:
- Role purpose: "What's a successful 6w outcome for you?"
- Top 3 priorities for the quarter
- Communication norms (async vs synchronous, slack channels)
- Feedback cadence & 1:1 schedule
- Immediate blockers (access, tooling, people)

Leah (People Ops): 30/60/90 measurable examples (fillable):
- 30d: complete local dev, open 1 small PR, pass CI; meet product & infra leads.
- 60d: own a small component area, reduce average PR review time by 20% (team baseline), add tests to cover flakiness.
- 90d: lead a minor release or feature, own a pager rotation, deliver a measurable perf or reliability improvement (e.g., -10% tail latency).

Diego (Eng Manager): Those are solid. Can we add "evidence" bullets managers should collect (PR links, test coverage, deploy logs) for check-ins?

Leah (People Ops): Yep  adding an "evidence" field per checkpoint (list of artifacts managers can use).

Maya (DevEx): For Day3 starter PR rubric include: unit tests included, lint passing, 1 reviewer from the squad, CI green or known flaky test note. Also add a small sample checklist managers can paste into PR description. Example PR template:
```
Summary: one sentence
Test plan: how to run locally
Checklist: [ ] tests added [ ] lint ok [ ] reviewer requested
```

Leah (People Ops): Buddy guidance: pick a peer (not manager), 4-week pairing plan, daily 15m stand week1 then twice weekly. Buddy hosts first-week "how we ship" demo.

Ivy (IT): Reminder: managers must cc IT in the intro email with hardware ticket number to speed up access. If you need rapid deprovisioning for contractors, note it in the ticket.

WelcomeBot: Week1 onboarding calendar created (10:00-12:00 daily local). Invitations sent to manager, buddy, and new hire.

Sam (new-hire): Thanks! Quick q: what's an acceptable size for Day3 PR?

Diego (Eng Manager): Hi Sam  aim for a small, useful change: docs fix, single test, or small bug (1-3 files). We'll pair if you'd like. Not trying to ship a feature yet.

Leah (People Ops): Final ops notes for managers: publish the editable 30/60/90 before start, confirm buddy 48h prior, file IT ticket at offer acceptance. I'll update the canonical one-pager and link examples by EOD. Please comment in the doc for role-specific additions. :memo:
